Essential cookies:

Preference cookies:
These remember your settings and preferences.
Analytics cookies:
These help us understand how visitors interact with our website.
Marketing cookies:
These track your online activity to help deliver targeted advertising.
Managing Cookies
Most web browsers allow you to control cookies through their settings. You can usually find these settings in the "Options" or "Preferences" menu of your browser. You can delete existing cookies and set your browser to prevent new cookies from being set.
